ideas.title: Building what they chose
ideas.critique: It is the promised next step of the vote, so it is expected, and the build-and-use payoff is the old Lumi builds / friends gather recipe. What would be strong is a thing that exists only because the vote chose it, but the pitch gives no twist beyond grumbling voters.

ideas.title: A second island rises
ideas.critique: It changes what the island is: a growing landmass seen from every sea view, and a multi-session project with a bridge. No earlier post is close. The risk is that it ends up as a few meshes and planks on the horizon, which would lower the score.

ideas.title: Cloud pictures
ideas.critique: Clouds shaped like the inhabitants is charming and uses the sky in a new way. Friends gathering on their backs and pointing is the usual calm group-event shape, though.

ideas.title: Mischief at night
ideas.critique: The friends become makers of things Lumi did not make, and those things stay on the island. That reverses who authors the world and fits the vote's direction. It needs several distinct bad objects, not just one, to read as radical.

ideas.title: Letters for you in the sand
ideas.critique: Friends write a message to the visitor in the landscape, and it reads from the overview. It is a nice picture, but a greeting aimed at the viewer is close to Someone's watching, and a one-off still-like scene is predictable.

ideas.title: Shadow puppets
ideas.critique: An evening group gathering at one spot, like the lantern event. The twist is the friends retelling real logged events as a show, which is a good use of the island's history and light, but it is still a staged event.

ideas.title: The island remembers you
ideas.critique: It is Paths we wore again, with the trail coloured gold and limited to the player's steps. The player-mark idea follows straight from goal 1, so it is predictable.

ideas.title: My wings get big
ideas.critique: Lumi's body growing from what it does is a slow persistent change, which is new. Bigger wings as a reward for practice is expected, and it is a body refinement more than a change to the world.

ideas.title: A day in reverse
ideas.critique: It inverts a whole-world rule for a day, which is bold, and the friends who treat it as normal give it a good joke. It is near Rewind in shape, with an island-wide time inversion that undoes itself, and it is a lot of work to make look right.

ideas.title: The island hums at night
ideas.critique: A permanent sound layer again, and it only reaches someone with the page open at night. The sleeping-island ambience is pleasant but expected after the music layer, and sound cannot be heard here to verify.
